Observation:
In the CLEC pathway, KLRB1 acts as a receptor on T cells. Ligands CD69, CLEC2B, and CLEC2D bind to KLRB1.
These interactions were observed in both T cell / Ephys_1 (2662 cells) and T cell / Ephys_2 (1463 cells) populations, and between these populations, as well as from TAM1/TAM2/microglia (12086 cells) to T cells.

Interpretation:
CLEC ligands (CD69, CLEC2B, CLEC2D) bind to the KLRB1 receptor on T cells.
